queries.source_title: Clean energy deserves clean rules. Charges against Columbus Energy
queries.proposition: UOKiK reported proceedings concerning a large Polish renewable-energy installer after complaints about delayed withdrawal refunds and questioned disclosures about cancellation rights, installation dates, and offered devices, indicating reachable trust and execution gaps around high-ticket home-energy purchases.
queries.contradiction: The selected page timed out when opened; its search extract reports allegations and continuing demand, but does not establish market-wide prevalence, final liability, service-unit economics, or willingness to pay for any proposed remedy.
queries.cheapest_resolving_test: Recruit 15 recent heat-pump or PV buyers through local owner groups and installers, verify documents and loss events, then ask for a refundable paid reservation for one narrowly specified remedy.

queries.search_text: site:nfz.gov.pl 2025 raport kolejki dostępność świadczeń ambulatoryjna opieka specjalistyczna Polska dane
queries.proposition: NFZ changed appointment reporting from 1 July 2026 and required cardiology providers to maintain schedules solely in Central e-Registration while still transmitting the central visit identifier in another message, creating a concrete workflow transition for providers and software vendors.
queries.contradiction: The notice proves changed reporting duties but gives no evidence of implementation failures, provider losses, patient demand, budget ownership, or applicability beyond the specified schedules and cardiology rollout.
queries.cheapest_resolving_test: Interview five cardiology-site registration managers and two medical-software vendors, map one week of exception handling, and request payment for a manual reconciliation pilot before building integration software.

concepts.title: Milestone Escrow for Home-Energy Installations
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: Replace installer-controlled prepayment with an independent milestone escrow that releases household funds only after documented delivery, commissioning, and handover.
concepts.customer: Polish households purchasing heat pumps, photovoltaics, batteries, or combined systems
concepts.loss_event: A large deposit is trapped after delay, withdrawal, substitution, or incomplete commissioning
concepts.payer: Household buyer, optionally subsidized by an accredited installer as a close-rate tool
concepts.authority_holder: Buyer and installer jointly under the escrow agreement
concepts.distributor: Regional installers, energy auditors, credit brokers, and consumer associations
concepts.risk_bearer: Licensed payment institution or bank partner; the venture does not custody funds itself
concepts.first_paid_event: A signed installation order funds an escrow setup fee
concepts.acquisition_route: Offer the family installation firm's prospects a paid escrow option, then white-label it to other installers
concepts.compounding_asset: An anonymized milestone, delay, defect, and installer-performance dataset
hypotheses: Buyers will pay to reduce deposit risk
Installers will accept objective milestones
A regulated partner can support low-volume pilots
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not hold client money without the required regulated payment structure or market unverified installers as certified.

concepts.title: Orphaned OZE Warranty Rescue
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: Give households with an unresponsive original seller one paid diagnostic entry point that identifies components, triages faults, and dispatches an accountable local repairer.
concepts.customer: Owners of residential PV and heat-pump systems lacking responsive after-sales support
concepts.loss_event: Heating or generation downtime persists because responsibility is fragmented among seller, installer, importer, and manufacturer
concepts.authority_holder: Homeowner for site access; manufacturer or warrantor for covered work
concepts.distributor: Local electricians, HVAC technicians, insurers, property managers, and search
concepts.risk_bearer: Repair contractor for workmanship; homeowner for uncovered equipment costs
concepts.first_paid_event: Fixed-price remote file review and on-site diagnostic booking
concepts.acquisition_route: Start from Wielkopolska service referrals through the family firm and publish model-specific repair intake pages
concepts.compounding_asset: Component compatibility graph, fault-resolution playbooks, and technician outcome history
hypotheses: A meaningful pool of systems is commercially orphaned
Independent technicians have spare capacity
Diagnostic fees cover triage and dispatch
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not represent manufacturer warranty authority that has not been contractually delegated.

concepts.title: Machine-Readable OZE Purchase Schedule
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: Turn vague renewable-installation quotes into a buyer-owned schedule naming every device, deadline, assumption, remedy, and subsidy dependency before signature.
concepts.customer: Households comparing high-ticket renewable installation offers
concepts.loss_event: The buyer signs an incomparable or underspecified proposal and later absorbs substitutions, delay, or performance ambiguity
concepts.authority_holder: Buyer decides whether to tender or sign; legal interpretation remains with a qualified lawyer
concepts.distributor: Mortgage advisers, energy auditors, consumer lawyers, and organic search
concepts.risk_bearer: Buyer retains investment-performance risk; service guarantees only document extraction accuracy
concepts.first_paid_event: Buyer purchases one red-flag and quote-normalization report
concepts.acquisition_route: Embed a sample comparison report in local quote requests and partner with independent auditors
concepts.compounding_asset: Clause library, normalized equipment catalogue, and observed quote benchmarks
hypotheses: Buyers receive materially inconsistent offers
A standardized schedule changes vendor choice
Low-touch review can be delivered profitably
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not provide individualized legal advice without qualified supervision or imply that a clean report guarantees performance.

concepts.title: Installer Conduct Monitor for Green Lenders
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: Sell lenders and subsidy intermediaries an early-warning feed built from installation milestones, refund aging, complaint patterns, and device substitutions across their contractor panels.
concepts.customer: Banks, loan brokers, insurers, and program operators financing household OZE installations
concepts.loss_event: A financed installer deteriorates operationally or behaviorally before panel managers detect concentration and remediation risk
concepts.authority_holder: Financier controls panel admission and monitoring decisions
concepts.distributor: Direct compliance and vendor-risk outreach to institutions, supported by installer-pool pilots
concepts.risk_bearer: Financier retains underwriting decisions; provider bears data-quality obligations
concepts.first_paid_event: Paid retrospective health check of one contractor portfolio
concepts.acquisition_route: Use a narrowly scoped anonymized local installer benchmark to secure a lender compliance pilot
concepts.compounding_asset: Longitudinal installer conduct and fulfillment-risk model
hypotheses: Financiers lack timely contractor-level signals
They can lawfully share necessary portfolio data
Avoided remediation supports enterprise pricing
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not scrape private complaints, process personal data without a lawful basis, or publish unverified accusations.

concepts.title: Measured-Outcome Heating Retrofit
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: Offer poorly performing heat-pump households a sensor-backed optimization retrofit priced partly from verified reductions in electricity use rather than another equipment sale.
concepts.customer: Heat-pump owners facing unexpectedly high consumption or comfort shortfalls
concepts.loss_event: The installed system runs inefficiently because design assumptions, controls, hydraulics, and building behavior were never reconciled
concepts.authority_holder: Homeowner approves control and hydraulic changes
concepts.distributor: Electricity-bill comparison pages, energy auditors, installers, and homeowner referrals
concepts.risk_bearer: Provider bears measurement and tuning-performance risk within a defined weather-normalized baseline
concepts.first_paid_event: Paid two-week monitoring and diagnosis package
concepts.acquisition_route: Pilot on existing family-firm installations and turn before-and-after cases into referral assets
concepts.compounding_asset: Weather-normalized operating dataset and equipment-specific tuning recipes
hypotheses: A measurable share of high bills is correctable without replacing equipment
Customers will share meter data
Savings can be attributed credibly enough for contingent pricing
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not promise savings before establishing a defensible baseline or alter safety-critical controls outside installer qualifications.

concepts.title: Central e-Registration Exception Bridge
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: Provide small NFZ cardiology sites a thin integration and exception queue that reconciles Central e-Registration identifiers with their existing medical and reporting systems.
concepts.customer: Independent and regional outpatient cardiology providers under NFZ contracts
concepts.loss_event: Staff re-enter appointments, lose identifiers, or submit inconsistent records across Central e-Registration and incumbent clinic software
concepts.authority_holder: Clinic director or authorized IT administrator
concepts.distributor: Medical-software resellers, NFZ billing consultants, and cardiology associations
concepts.risk_bearer: Clinic retains statutory reporting responsibility; provider bears contracted integration defects
concepts.first_paid_event: Fixed-fee workflow audit and reconciliation pilot
concepts.acquisition_route: Offer five cardiology clinics a paid manual exception service before automating repeated mappings
concepts.compounding_asset: Connector library and de-identified catalogue of integration exceptions
hypotheses: Existing systems leave material reconciliation work
Clinics control a software budget
Interfaces permit a compliant thin layer
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not access health data without processor agreements, minimum-necessary controls, and authorized system interfaces.

concepts.title: Recovered-Slot Exchange for Specialty Clinics
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: Detect likely cancellations and route released specialty appointments to eligible patients already waiting, charging clinics only for attended recovered slots.
concepts.customer: Outpatient specialty clinics with scarce appointment capacity and no-show leakage
concepts.loss_event: A late cancellation or no-show leaves reimbursable clinical capacity unused while patients remain queued
concepts.authority_holder: Clinic controls eligibility, clinical priority, and appointment allocation
concepts.distributor: Clinic-management vendors, NFZ billing advisers, and specialty networks
concepts.risk_bearer: Clinic retains clinical-priority decisions; provider is paid only for attended incremental visits
concepts.first_paid_event: First verified attended visit filled from a released slot
concepts.acquisition_route: Run a human-operated SMS and call pilot in one clinic using its approved waitlist
concepts.compounding_asset: Clinic-specific attendance model and response-time routing data
hypotheses: Clinics have measurable late slot leakage
Waitlisted patients accept short-notice offers
Central scheduling rules allow clinic-controlled backfill
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not bypass medical priority, sell queue position, or message patients without a valid care relationship and consent basis.

concepts.title: NFZ Schedule Reconciliation Assurance
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: Continuously compare clinic source schedules, central identifiers, and submitted messages, then produce an auditable exception ledger before discrepancies become reimbursement or compliance disputes.
concepts.loss_event: Schedule and reporting mismatches survive until manual audit, rejected settlement, or patient complaint
concepts.payer: Provider group's finance or compliance function
concepts.beneficiary: Provider group and patients whose appointments remain traceable
concepts.distributor: NFZ settlement consultancies, auditors, and healthcare IT integrators
concepts.risk_bearer: Provider remains accountable for submissions; service warrants detection against agreed rules
concepts.first_paid_event: Paid one-month retrospective reconciliation of a single site
concepts.acquisition_route: Sell through billing consultants already resolving rejected or ambiguous records
concepts.compounding_asset: Versioned reporting-rule engine and mismatch signature library
hypotheses: Cross-system discrepancies occur often enough to matter
Records can be reconciled without replacing core software
Compliance owners will fund preventive assurance
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not claim official NFZ certification or silently change source records and submissions.

concepts.title: Employer-Funded Specialty Access Navigator
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: Use official availability data plus a human navigator to find, verify, and coordinate earlier eligible NFZ specialty appointments for employees, without buying priority access.
concepts.customer: Polish employers whose staff lose workdays navigating fragmented specialist access
concepts.loss_event: An employee repeatedly searches, calls, travels, or delays care because published availability and booking steps are hard to navigate
concepts.authority_holder: Patient chooses providers and authorizes assistance; clinics retain allocation authority
concepts.distributor: Occupational-health brokers, benefits platforms, and mid-market HR teams
concepts.risk_bearer: Employer pays subscription; navigator guarantees process effort, not clinical access
concepts.first_paid_event: Employer funds a capped pilot for one workforce cohort
concepts.acquisition_route: Sell a low-volume concierge pilot to Warsaw employers with measured search time and completed booking outcomes
concepts.compounding_asset: Verified access-path directory and non-clinical booking-resolution playbooks
hypotheses: Employers bear visible productivity losses
Official availability can be verified efficiently
Employees consent to limited data processing
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not reserve appointments speculatively, resell public slots, impersonate patients, or give medical advice.

concepts.title: Clinic Vendor Exit Pack
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: Give small clinics a fixed-price, vendor-neutral export and continuity pack so schedule, identifier, and reporting workflows remain operable when they replace or dispute an incumbent software supplier.
concepts.customer: Small and mid-sized NFZ clinics dependent on a single medical-software vendor
concepts.loss_event: Switching is deferred because data exports, interface knowledge, and reporting continuity are controlled by the incumbent
concepts.payer: Clinic owner or acquiring clinic group
concepts.authority_holder: Clinic data controller and management board
concepts.distributor: Healthcare M&A advisers, clinic accountants, IT integrators, and medical chambers
concepts.risk_bearer: Clinic chooses the replacement system; service bears contracted export-validation obligations
concepts.first_paid_event: Paid portability and continuity assessment before termination notice
concepts.acquisition_route: Partner with one independent medical IT consultant and sell an assessment to clinics already facing renewal
concepts.compounding_asset: Export-schema library, migration checklists, and vendor-specific continuity maps
hypotheses: Clinic switching costs are materially driven by data and workflow opacity
Contracts permit controller-directed exports
A repeatable pre-migration pack reduces outage risk
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not circumvent access controls, breach software licenses, or extract data without the clinic controller's documented authority.
